g.text: LLMs can be categorized along five key axes
each token attends only to preceding
Enc: NER, QA | Dec: Chat | Enc-Dec: Seq2Seq
Enc: 1 pass | Dec: n passes | Enc-Dec: n passes
All params active vs top-k routing
Every parameter active for every token. Full compute cost per token.
Only subset of experts activated per token (top-2 routing).
~15–30% active params — more capacity per FLOP.
Weights publicly released for self-hosting. Full control,
Accessible only via paid API. Proprietary architecture,
weights, and training data. Enterprise SLAs.
